THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
MODERN PROPORTION
045
60 / Heart Bag
Black Bows
A fitted black cardigan jacket with a crisp white collar and cuffs
and jeweled buttons, worn with a black pleated mini skirt. She
holds a heart-shaped blush bag laced with black ribbon bows, in
a paneled wood room beside a carved chair.
61 / Cream Suite
Beret Tailoring
A cream cropped jacket with a rounded collar, pearl buttons and
patch pockets over a matching A-line mini skirt with a
gold-buckle belt. A cream beret, rimless glasses, layered pearl
necklaces and a quilted chain bag complete the look against a
pale wall.
